requirement.statement: The project SHALL support ORM implementation metadata for relation declarations through Kunun prefix annotations without changing core type compatibility.

case.given: A source declares `#(orm #relation :{ ... })` immediately before `(relation #B_to_A :{ from = B to = A })`
case.when: The source is parsed and annotation extraction runs
case.then: The ORM marker SHALL be associated with the relation Knot as a pre modifier annotation

case.given: A relation declaration has an ORM prefix annotation
case.when: The type binder processes the source
case.then: The binder SHALL still register the relation using only core relation endpoint semantics
case.and: The ORM metadata SHALL NOT affect row compatibility or schema subtype checks

case.given: An ORM relation annotation contains `from = { field = relation_b2 keys = [_b2] }` and `to = { field = rev__B__relation_b2 keys = [_id] }`
case.when: The ORM relation annotation profile parses the marker
case.then: The profile SHALL expose normalized endpoint descriptors with field names, join keys, visibility, and foreign-key placement

case.given: An ORM relation annotation contains relation type and endpoint display names
case.when: The ORM relation annotation profile parses the marker
case.then: The profile SHALL expose depa-orm-compatible relation type and endpoint field-name metadata

case.given: An ORM relation annotation contains `through = [ (through #Entity :{ from_keys = [...] to_keys = [...] }) ]`
case.when: The ORM relation annotation profile parses the marker
case.then: The profile SHALL preserve ordered through path segments and their constraints

case.given: An ORM relation annotation contains `write = { cascade_delete = delete }`
case.when: The ORM relation annotation profile parses the marker
case.then: The profile SHALL expose write behavior separately from core relation typing

case.given: A depa-orm `RelationshipDefinition` uses origin/target entities, field keys, join keys, relationship type, visibility, and cascade delete
case.when: The definition is migrated to Kunun
case.then: The migration SHALL produce one `(relation ...)` declaration plus one prefix `#(orm #relation :{ ... })` annotation

case.given: A depa-orm relation uses `RelationPathThrough[]` for many-to-many or multi-hop joins
case.when: The definition is migrated to Kunun
case.then: The migration SHALL preserve the through path order, join keys, foreign-key flags, and constraints

case.given: A Kunun schema field carries attrs, metadata, and prefix annotations needed by depa-orm FieldDefinition
case.when: The type binder creates row members
case.then: The row member SHALL preserve field-level metadata for downstream ORM definition generation

case.given: A Kunun schema field declares a core type such as `!String` and has `#(domain #field :{ ... })` plus `#(orm #field :{ ... })` prefix annotations
case.when: The annotation profiles parse the field Knot or bound row member
case.then: The profiles SHALL expose business type and ORM scalar mapping descriptors
case.and: The core type registry SHALL NOT need to register those business scalar names as language built-ins
